name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v541: Re-added kwik.cx to Cloudflare bypass. kwik.cx now uses the same plugin bypass as AnimePahe sites - invisible when 'Hide Cloudflare WebView' is enabled, visible fallback otherwise. This prevents CloudflareKiller from wiping the shared cookie jar and removes the jar-purge hazard that caused repeated solves and lost AnimePahe cookies. All v540 fixes retained: 15-second solve cooldown, 30-second poll timeout, visible fallback, always require cf_clearance, removed dead JS cookie probe, clear in-flight bypass on dismiss, background API config load, tightened WebView security, removed double-poll, alpha=0 invisible attach.
